The Film Behind the Painted Wall

彩绘墙后面的那卷电影 · 649 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A cinema planned an exhibition of its original posters. A painter named Jules arrived to repair a wall before the opening. Its latest design showed a cheerful clown with a red hat. Beneath a loose corner, he saw a different outline. A much older portrait showed a woman holding a string instrument. The director wanted to cover the whole wall with a reproduction of a famous movie advertisement. Jules asked him to wait until they could identify the earlier artwork.

2The cinema studio had antique postcards and an early photograph. A geometric border matched a decorative line on the wall. The painter found a triangle near a gorgeous fountain. In a second image, a guitarist stood at the same spot. An advertisement showed him in an elegant jacket. The woman in the portrait held the same instrument. The resemblance was close. Jules could now relate the painting to a real performance. It was a clue to the artist's inspiration, not proof of originality.

3A retired actress remembered a jazz concert before the cinema switched to horror and theatrical drama. A documentary used an instrumental soundtrack from the concert. The old reel looked dull. A modern version showed a colorful cartoon and a brilliant star above the stage. The animation had been added for entertainment. Jules asked the director to check the original, since a lively effect could create an illusion of what people actually saw.

4In the older film a young woman passed a circus poster and a merchant's window. Her distinctive posture matched the figure on the wall. An abstract shape behind her resolved into a triangular stage curtain. She handed a painter a ticket and turned toward the crowd. A signature appeared below the image. The scene identified a well-known local sculptor who had made a contribution to the cinema before his sculpture entered a gallery. That discovery gave the wall a place in his career.

5The restoration team tested a small patch. The old paint was fragile. Removing the clown could damage the authentic surface. The director proposed hiding the marks with a fresh design. Jules made a different puzzle for visitors. A photographic overlay showed the two-dimensional outline without claiming to restore every brushstroke. The two styles, decorative splendor and plain realism, could share an exhibit. The group kept the evidence visible rather than pursue the perfection of a single magnificent image.

6A painter from a contemporary gallery helped the team compare the layers. The clown's purple hat had a graceful curve, while the old musician's figure was more angular. A film student wanted to imitate both as if one artist had painted them. Jules asked her to make a vivid diagram instead. A visitor could compare the colors and artistic choices without mistaking an idealized drawing for the wall's original beauty.

7The opening used the old film with its own soundtrack. An interviewer asked whether they had uncovered a priceless masterpiece. Jules said the wall mattered because it linked a local artist to a real event. The director had expected the story to end with one remarkable image. A few seconds of film had changed the whole account. He placed a square card beside the curtain. It listed the artist, the performer, and the film worker who had recorded them.

8A visitor returned after they switched off the projection. The older design made her curious. She had come for a picture of a notable twentieth-century celebrity. She stayed to look at the older musician's instrument. Jules showed her a figurative drawing beside a conceptual sketch made for the film. A jewel and a curl of hair appeared in both. The resemblance gave the team an interesting lead without establishing who had played. She traced the triangle on a postcard, then told her daughter where the painter had first lifted the corner. She could explain the discovery without borrowing the glamour of the later poster.

四级汇总词汇 · 26中文译文

彩绘墙后面的那卷电影

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一家电影院准备展出早年的海报。油漆工朱尔斯在开幕前来修一面墙。最外一层画着戴红帽的笑脸小丑。掀起松动的墙角，底下有另一道轮廓，年代早得多的肖像上，女人手持弦乐器。经理想用一张著名电影广告的复制品盖住整墙。朱尔斯请他等一等，先弄清旧画是谁的作品。

2影院工作室存着老明信片和早期照片。明信片的几何边框与墙上的装饰线吻合。画工在漂亮喷泉附近找到一个三角形。另一张照片里，吉他手站在同一位置，广告上他穿着一件考究夹克。肖像里的女人拿的也是这件乐器，相似之处很明显。朱尔斯终于能把画和真实演出联系起来。这可以解释画家从哪来的灵感，还不足以证明原作是谁画的。

3一位退休演员记得，影院改放恐怖片和舞台剧前曾有一场爵士音乐会。一部纪录片以音乐会的器乐录音为配乐。旧胶卷光泽暗淡，新版却在舞台上方加了彩色卡通和一颗耀眼的星。动画是后来为了好看才加的。朱尔斯请经理查原版，生动的效果可能让观众以为当时亲眼就能看见那些东西。

4老片里，一位年轻女子走过马戏海报和商店橱窗。她独特的站姿和墙上的人物一样。身后的抽象图形逐渐清晰，原来是三角形舞台帘。她把票递给一位画家，再转身面向人群。画面下方露出一个签名，指向一位当地知名雕塑家。作品进美术馆前，他曾为电影院做过事。这面墙也就有了他职业生涯中的位置。

5修复队先试一小块。旧颜料很脆，去掉小丑可能伤到原表面。经理提议用新图案遮住痕迹，朱尔斯想给观众一个谜题。照片叠图能显示二维轮廓，无须声称还原了每一笔。华丽的装饰风格和朴素的写实风格可以同时展出。他们保留线索，让两层都看得见。

6当代画廊的一位画家来帮忙比较。小丑的紫帽有优美的弧线，旧乐手的身形则棱角更分明。电影系学生想模仿两层，好像出自同一人之手。朱尔斯请她改画一张鲜明的示意图。观众可以比较颜色和画法，理想化的重绘也不会被当成墙面原有的样子。

7开幕时，他们放老片和原配乐。记者问是不是挖出了一件无价名作。朱尔斯说，墙的意义在于把当地艺术家和真实演出连在一起。经理原以为故事会停在一张特别的画，几秒胶片却改写了经过。他把方卡摆在帘旁，列出画家、表演者和拍下他们的电影工作人员。

8关掉投影后，一位访客又回来了。旧图案引起她的好奇。她原为看一名二十世纪名人而来，现在留下看早年乐手的乐器。朱尔斯把具象画和电影的构想草图摆在一起，两张都有一颗珠宝和一缕卷发。相似给了他们有意思的线索，还不能确认谁演奏了。访客顺着明信片上的三角形描了一遍，告诉女儿画工先从哪一角掀开。她现在不用借后期海报的华丽，也能把发现讲明白。
